conceptAngle: 一张深色工作台上的一条流水线：同一个帧号从左边进去，每一站都当场亮出自己的产物（数值、画面、图片、视频），最后流水线自己证明它可以拆开并行、也可以不出图就检查。

typography.zh: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

colorSemantics.rule: frame number is always lime; each value keeps its own color everywhere it appears (row, wire, chart curve); saturated color only for these semantic roles

depth: flat panels with one shadow level; dimmed = opacity 0.28 + desaturate
camera: world container; starts scale 1.18 centred on the left (frame chip + function), eases to 1.0 by b4 when the scene panel opens; static afterwards

representativeStaticFrames.heroComposition: HeroFrame (all objects at max information, rendered before any entrance work)
